msg: Pregunta, supongo que no están saliendo con el clima verdad?
reply:
Las salidas se suspenden solo si las condiciones meteorológicas afectan la seguridad. Si la Capitanía de Puerto cierra las salidas, primero intentamos reprogramar; si no es posible, se reembolsa el 100%.

Operamos todos los días del año salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero, y la seguridad va primero: si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma. La previsión de un día concreto te la confirma el equipo: te paso ahora con alguien que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions and have referral paperwork, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* sounds like the right option to finish your certification. The referral paperwork must be signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course. It’s a separate activity and *doesn’t count toward your certification*. You’ll need to stay overnight on the Rosario Islands during the referral course; accommodation isn’t included. The refresher includes a same-day return to Cartagena, so please check the travel logistics for doing it the day before the course.

For the referral course details: https://divingplanet.org/curso-padi-cartagena/referido/

The referral course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊
